description: Hermes-facing search combo. Primary path: OmniRoute /v1/search with provider fallback Tavily → Firecrawl → SearXNG. Direct adapters are secondary when Omni is unavailable.
notes: Combo name web-search (Router Worker health field web_combo).
WEB_BACKENDS default omni,tavily,firecrawl,searxng — Omni first, then direct adapters.
Per-provider timeout WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT_S (default 20s) keeps failover bounded.
Extract stays on Router Worker (SearXNG cannot extract).
